notes: V7.1.9: NEW Make-Your-Own-Bot tab (corner button between UNIVERSE and TOOLS) — describe a strategy in plain English, pick Anthropic / OpenAI / OpenRouter, paste your API key, generate a bot.py the AI wrote. Save locally or publish to the APEX store. Plus daybot fix: bracket exit legs (take-profit + stop-loss) are now GTC instead of DAY, so Alpaca no longer cancels them at 16:00 ET. Includes a re-arm safety net: if any open position is found with no live exit orders (e.g. a legacy DAY bracket that already expired), the bot places fresh GTC TP/SL legs on startup.
